name: Practiced Ally Positioning (Combat)
body:
You have worked with allies to ensure that they do not block your shots.

Prerequisite(s): Precise Shot

Benefit(s): When making a ranged attack against a target that is provided cover by one of your allies, you may ignore that cover bonus to AC provided by the ally. Cover from other sources are not affected.
